summary: Starting with ansible-core 2.21, Ansible can run PowerShell modules with PowerShell 7 (pwsh) instead of Windows PowerShell 5.1. This allows PowerShell modules to run on Windows and non-Windows systems and use newer PowerShell features.
questions: Which ansible-core version added pwsh support?
Can PowerShell modules run on Linux targets with Ansible?

answer_card.title: PowerShell 7 support in Ansible
answer_card.answer_md: From **ansible-core 2.21**, Ansible supports PowerShell 7 (`pwsh`) as an alternative to Windows PowerShell 5.1 for running PowerShell modules. This makes cross-platform module execution possible on Windows and non-Windows systems, with access to newer PowerShell features.
